package: geoxgboost 1.1.0 (optimize_bw, Adaptive kernel, spatial weights, n_splits=3)
decision: Geographically weighted XGBoost as shipped (one local XGBoost + GridSearchCV per training row, dense n x n distance matrix) is not feasible at this scale; use a global XGBoost with fold-internal k-NN-8 spatial lag, rotated coordinates and nested Optuna tuning under spatial-block CV (src/model_xgb.py).
